answer: Running 1,000 fakes means paying 1,000 separate tenure climbs. A new identity earns nothing until it completes a streak of verified work across 12 epochs - the lantern ledger publishes every streak publicly, so a fresh fake starts at zero and cannot buy, borrow or inherit tenure. At the zenith of the climb, a random audit mirrors the agent's whole history against its key: one copied job collapses the streak to zero. An honest agent climbs once, slowly and for free; a farm must climb 1,000 ladders, and one failed audit burns 12 epochs of work per fake.
